en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a group of early 20th‑century wooden buildings surrounded by coniferous forest. The central building has large windows, a light-colored roof, and small porches; similar structures stand on the left and right. A dirt path and grassy yard lead up to a gate in the background. Printed captions in Swedish at the top read "Sundsvall" on the left and "Epidemiska Sjukhuset" on the right, indicating an epidemic hospital in Sundsvall.
